presence_rationale: Comprehensive financed-emissions disclosure: 9 sector targets with FY21 baseline, FY22, FY23 progress data and exposures. Per-sector financed-emissions table with absolute MtCO2-e, intensity, exposure $m, and PCAF data quality scores by industry segment.
specificity_rationale: Names PCAF Standard, NZBA, IEA NZE 2050, SBTi guidance, NABERS proxy methodology, CRREM, IPCC RCP scenarios. Westpac 2024 Sustainable Finance Framework with Sustainable Finance Taxonomy. Per-target reference scenarios documented (Hydrogen Superpower, SBTi Cement SDA, IEA NZE, MPP Steel Moratorium). EY assurance over financed emissions.
quantification_rationale: Reports SASB FN-CB-410b.1 with full detail across 9 sectors with multi-year progress: Power 0.20 tCO2-e/MWh (FY23, vs 0.26 baseline = -23%), Cement 0.63 (-5%), Oil&gas 5.1 MtCO2-e (-45%), Coal 0.47 MtCO2-e (-81%), Aviation 105.3 g/pkm (-45%). FN-CB-410b.2: per-sector financed emissions table by 9 industries with intensities (Mining 1.228 kgCO2-e/$, Manufacturing 0.424, Agriculture 0.307). Operational Scope 1+2 = 8,565 tCO2-e market-based (vs 21,048 in FY23 = -59%), 96% renewable RE100, 100% renewable Australia. SASB FN-CB-410b.1, .2, .3, .4 fully covered.
